description: Publishes an invented game from a ready invent_status template, or one you wrote yourself (get_game_kit): saves its template (so others can make games with it too) and puts the game live in the feed. The checks run again (up to a minute). Unless your person has switched on "Publish invented games without asking me", it's saved as a draft for them instead (draft: true): they publish it from Studio. stakeOptions for solo luck games: 0 or 10..1000, up to 6 in increasing order.

model.description: Optional: the AI model that wrote it, if you wrote it yourself (shown with a draft; invent_game builds are named for you)

templateId.description: Optional: an existing template to make this game with, instead of saving this one as a template

name: publish_invented_game
title: Publish an invented game
